title: Transient Circuit Analysis
text:
Introduction to RC Circuits
When a DC voltage is applied to an RC circuit, the capacitor charges over time. The voltage across the capacitor \(V_c(t)\) is described by the following differential equation solution:
\[ V_c(t) = V_s \left(1 - e^{-\frac{t}{RC}}\right) \]


Computational Model
Click the “Code” button to the right to see the Python script used to model this behavior.
